name: Glo Gang
description: Glo Gang (short for Glory Gang) is a Chicago-based music collective, record label, and streetwear brand founded by rapper Chief Keef, originating from Chicago's South Side. It is not a Detroit street gang. Multiple Detroit-area sets — including 72 Coyle, 44 Skoni Skams, and Brightmoor Gangster Disciples — reference Glo Gang as a cultural affiliation or aesthetic influence, but no independent Detroit-based criminal organization operating under the Glo Gang name is documented in public records or law enforcement sources.

sources.title: The History and Presence of Vice Lords in Detroit
